human_summary: Strict sequential nonce guard for the live autotrader lane with externally supplied expected nonce and explicit bv32 wraparound semantics.
assumptions: The host computes expected_nonce from live session state before invoking Tau.
All arithmetic is unsigned bv32 arithmetic with wraparound semantics.
The bounded assurance domain exercises representative boundary values including 0, 1, 2, and 0xFFFFFFFF for each input stream.

intended_preconditions: The live submit lane treats o4 as the authoritative acceptance bit.
Sparse or out-of-order nonce schemes are out of scope for this v1 contract.

analysis_partitions.intent: The host-provided expected nonce disagrees with the strict next-nonce relation.
Wraparound and stale/equal intent-nonce cases block freshness even if expected nonce is locally consistent.
A nonce can be fresh without matching the exact expected next nonce.

outputs.name: o4
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i3 == ((i2 + 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF) and i1 > i2 and i1 == i3) else 0

theorems.statement: For all inputs in the explicit domain, o4 = 1 implies the expected-next relation, freshness, and strict sequentiality all hold.
For all inputs in the explicit domain, if the expected-next relation, freshness, and strict sequentiality all hold, then o4 = 1.
Distinct autotrader_nonce_guard_v1 output-vector regions are pairwise disjoint over the explicit domain.
The autotrader_nonce_guard_v1 behavior atlas covers the explicit domain.
The contract semantics and the Tau binary agree on the explicit autotrader_nonce_guard_v1 assurance domain.

evidence_links.note: Explicit-domain parity cases for the nonce guard.
Independent shadow semantics for strict sequential nonce acceptance.
